subject: Deep-dive: Migration PoC architecture review and scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@acme.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Deep-dive & migration PoC architecture review

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We're evaluating a migration from our current self-hosted inference stack (on-prem GPUs + a light orchestration layer) to a managed inference provider for predictable latency and cost. Before greenlighting a PoC we need a technical deep-dive with your infra/serving folks to cover: model compatibility, quantization/precision options, network egress/security, and rollback strategies.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute architecture review next week? Preferable windows (PST): Tue 11/03 10:00–12:00 or Thu 11/05 14:00–16:00. If those don't work, send alternatives. I've attached our high-level questionnaire and a recent infra diagram for background.

Primary attendees from our side: Sara Lim (Eng lead), Devon Hall (Platform eng), Procurement distribution list.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lim
Lead, ML Platform — Acme Robotics

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_POC_Questionnaire.pdf, current_infra_diagram.png

Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Deep-dive & migration PoC architecture review

Hi Sara — great to connect. Thanks for the materials; they were helpful.

We can absolutely do an architecture review and scope a PoC. Proposed 60-minute slots (PST):
- Tue 11/03 10:30–11:30
- Thu 11/05 14:30–15:30

I copied Monica (solutions engineering) and Marissa (customer engineering) — they'll own the technical walkthrough and runbook discussion.

Agenda suggestion (we can tweak):
1) Quick intros & goals (10 min)
2) Current infra constraints & top migration risks (10 min)
3) Serving runtime/compat questions (quantization, KV cache) (20 min)
4) Network/security + deployment modes (10 min)
5) Next steps & PoC success criteria (10 min)

Can you confirm which slot works or propose two alternatives? Also helpful if Devon can share the current model sizes and peak qps.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0147
